name: unlock_all_clears_every_lock
note: actions.yaml unlock_all: `doc.op: {op: unlock_all}` clears the flag on every element at every depth, a layer's own included, and keeps the selection (UNLOCKSEL). Expected bytes from the engine's native table before the YAML route existed; the Mac reproduces them independently.

name: hide_selection_hides_and_clears_the_selection
note: actions.yaml hide_selection: `doc.op: {op: hide_selection}` sets each selected element invisible and clears the selection.

name: show_all_reveals_and_selects_what_it_showed
note: actions.yaml show_all: `doc.op: {op: show_all}` makes every invisible element visible and selects exactly those (here both rects, hidden by the step before).
